Pool8Ball.title: 8-Ball Billiards
Pool8Ball.playerWinDesc: Incredible! You mastered the table and defeated the {botTitle}!
Pool8Ball.playerLossDesc: Alexa claimed the 8-Ball and won the match. Better luck next time!
Pool8Ball.noBallHitSub: Cue ball failed to contact any object ball
Pool8Ball.wrongBallFirstSub: You must hit your assigned ball category first
Pool8Ball.eightBallEarlySub: 8-Ball was pocketed before cleaning your category
Pool8Ball.noCushionTouchSub: At least one ball must hit a cushion after contact
Pool8Ball.ballInHandSub: Drag and click to place the cue ball anywhere on the table
Pool8Ball.alexaBallInHandSub: Alexa is placing the cue ball...
Pool8Ball.turnSub: Take aim and plan your shot!
Pool8Ball.tutorialWelcome: Welcome to 8-Ball Billiards! Learn aiming, power control, ball placement, and cue spin.
Pool8Ball.tutorialAiming: Aiming: Drag anywhere on screen to rotate your Cue Stick towards Ball 3.
Pool8Ball.tutorialPower: Power Shot: Aim at Ball 3, pull back the left Power Meter / Cue Stick, and release to shoot!
Pool8Ball.tutorialSelection: Ball Selection: Pot Solid balls (1-7) while avoiding scratching the Cue Ball into pockets.
Pool8Ball.tutorialBallInHand: Ball-in-Hand: Drag & place the Cue Ball anywhere on table, then pot Ball 4!
Pool8Ball.tutorialSpin: Cue Spin: Tap the Spin icon on the left to set Cue Spin, then strike Ball 1!
Pool8Ball.tutorialVictory: 8-Ball Victory: Clear your assigned balls, then pot the Black 8-Ball to win!
Pool8Ball.tutorialPractice: Great Job! Take free practice shots or click 'Skip' to start your first match!
Pool8Ball.tutScratchAim3: Scratch! Aim at Ball 3 without scratching.
Pool8Ball.tutMissedBall3: Missed Ball 3! Aim at Ball 3, pull back the Power Meter, and release to shoot.
Pool8Ball.tutScratchPower3: Scratch! Aim at Ball 3, pull back the Power Meter carefully, and release.
Pool8Ball.tutNotPocketed3: Ball 3 wasn't pocketed! Aim at Ball 3, pull back the Power Meter on the left, and release.
Pool8Ball.tutScratchSuit: Scratch! Aim for a Solid or Stripe ball.
Pool8Ball.tutPocketedSuit: Excellent! You pocketed a suit ball!
Pool8Ball.tutNoSuitPocketed: No suit ball pocketed. Line up a shot into any pocket!
Pool8Ball.tutScratchBallInHand: Scratch! Place the cue ball with Ball-in-Hand and hit Ball 4.
Pool8Ball.tutWellDoneBallInHand: Well Done! Ball-in-Hand gives you complete table control!
Pool8Ball.tutPlaceCloser: Place the cue ball closer to Ball 4 and strike it!
Pool8Ball.tutScratchSpin: Scratch! Set spin and hit Ball 1 cleanly.
Pool8Ball.tutSpinNotApplied: Spin not applied! Tap the Spin button on the left to set spin before shooting.
Pool8Ball.tutPerfectSpinControl: Perfect Spin Control! Notice how cue ball reaction changed.
Pool8Ball.tutSetSpinStrike1: Set spin and strike Ball 1 to complete!
Pool8Ball.tutScratch8Ball: Scratch with 8-Ball is an instant loss! Try again carefully.
